version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This Jira skill is a disclosed Maton-based integration for Jira access and automation, with no hidden or malicious behavior found in the artifacts.

dimensions.detail: Network access, Bash, and a Maton account are proportionate for a Jira API integration, but users should understand that connected Jira data may include business and personal data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires the Maton CLI via pinned npm or Homebrew instructions; the package ships Markdown guidance only and no executable scripts in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill includes broad Maton platform reference material for functions, triggers, destinations, and raw API calls, but it repeatedly scopes those to user-requested actions, defaults to read/list operations, and requires explicit approval for writes, new connections, deployments, destinations, and local --exec use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth credentials are stored by the Maton CLI in the OS credential store, and connections, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations can persist; the artifact discloses this and gives approval, scoping, and deletion guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Jira API access through managed OAuth, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: list/search Jira data, create/update/delete issues, transition issues, add comments, and optionally automate approved Jira workflows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using Maton as the OAuth gateway for Jira. Confirm the Jira account, connection, and OAuth scopes before use, and require explicit confirmation before any write, delete, hosted function, trigger, or destination that could keep running or forward data.
